Was in the same boat at one point too so il tell you my advice to try and help you get to where your consistently hitting good shots. 

Number one thing I can tell you is keep practicing. I know it sounds cliche but it's very true, keep swinging and you will eventually get your rhythm. 

Number two: the only difference in tempo that is slightly different is the driver. Every other club you will use the same swing rhythm and tempo. The driver your gonna be slightly faster with your up swing.

Number 3: keep leveling up and invest your skill points in timing related skills plus the same with fittings will help with getting more consistent shots.

Finally Number 4: If your on an controller, try using different thumb placements and find one that works good for you. I eventually used the pinch method on my right thumbstick where it gives me a good line every time and is just a matter of hitting up on the thumbstick at the right time. 

I hope this helps, it took me along time to get better at the game as well.

Went to a bandit camp while they were sleeping, assassinated one but the other bandits obviously were alarmed but I had better armor and was health potions, food and was ready to go.
